intro: Flower kaomoji (also spelled flower kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces decorated with ❀, ✿, and ❁ flowers — soft, cottagecore, and full of cheer. A flower kaomoji like (◠‿◠✿) or (◕‿◕)❀ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and usernames. Browse flower faces, flower crowns, faces holding flowers, and blooming faces below and click any face to copy it instantly.
